profile.ja: 吸血鬼。紅血卿の側近であり、代々紅血卿に仕える家系の生まれで、紅血卿の護衛として常に行動をともにする。実直な性格で、紅血卿のためなら己の身すら投げ打つという。刃にルーンが刻まれた二刀流のチェーンソー“シヴァ”を武器としている。金竜騎士団の魔界騎士であり、紅血卿直属の暗殺団にも属す随一の実力者で、金色の死神の異名を持つ。常に紅血卿に付き従うマリカは、彼女の夏の保養にも同行する。だが今年の保養先は海であり、水着を着るようにと主から命じられてしまう。
profile.en: She is a vampire and a close aide to the Crimson Blood Lord, born into a family that has served the Crimson Blood Lord for generations. She constantly acts as his guard. She has an earnest personality and will even sacrifice herself for the Crimson Blood Lord. Her weapon is the dual-bladed chainsaw "Shiva," etched with runes. She is a demon-realm knight of the Golden Dragon Knights and the top operative in the Crimson Blood Lord's personal assassination unit, bearing the nickname "Golden Reaper." Marika always follows the Crimson Blood Lord and even accompanies him on his summer retreats. This year's retreat is at the beach, and the Master has ordered her to wear a swimsuit.
